tools.why: Enables moving deleted files to the desktop trash (with undo) on Linux instead of a permanent delete. gio (from GNOME/glib2) is tried first and usually already present; trash-put (trash-cli) is the fallback worth installing on a minimal/non-GNOME setup.
Powers the fast in-directory grep search feature and the smart-rename reference scanner. Without it, both are unavailable rather than falling back to something slower.
